strings.asyncbackupcompletedetail:
The backup process has completed successfully.
You can access the backup on the restore page.
strings.asyncbackuperrordetail: The backup process has failed. Please contact your system administrator.
strings.asyncbadexecution: Bad backup controller execution. It is {$a} and should be 2.
strings.asynccheckprogress: You can check the progress at any time on the restore page.
strings.asyncemailenabledetail: If enabled, users will receive a notification when an asynchronous backup or restore completes.
strings.asyncmessagebodydefault: Your {operation} (ID: {backupid}) has completed successfully. You can access it here: {link}.
strings.asyncmessagebodydetail: Notification to send when an asynchronous backup or restore completes.
strings.asyncnowait: You don't need to wait here, as the process will continue in the background.
strings.asyncrestorecompletedetail: The restore process has completed successfully. Clicking continue will take you to the course for the restored item.
strings.asyncrestoreerrordetail: The restore process has failed. Please contact your system administrator.
strings.asyncrestoreinprogress_help: Asynchronous course restores that are in progress are shown here.
strings.autoactivedescription: Choose whether or not to do automated backups. If manual is selected automated backups will be possible only by through the automated backups CLI script. This can be done either manually on the command line or through cron.
strings.automatedbackupschedulehelp: Choose which days of the week to perform automated backups.
strings.automatedbackupsinactive: Automated backups haven't been enabled by the site admin
strings.automatedmaxkepthelp: This specifies the maximum number of recent automated backups to be kept for each course. Older backups will be deleted automatically.
strings.automatedminkepthelp: If backups older than a specified number of days are deleted, it can happen that an inactive course ends up with no backup. To prevent this, a minimum number of backups kept should be specified.
strings.automatedstoragehelp: Choose the location where you want backups to be stored when they are automatically created.
strings.backupautoactivitiesdescription: Sets the default for including activities in a backup. For the recycle bin to work, this setting must be enabled.
strings.backupdetailsnonstandardinfo: The selected file is not a standard Moodle backup file. The restore process will try to convert the backup file into the standard format and then restore it.
strings.cannotfindassignablerole: The {$a} role in the backup file cannot be mapped to any of the roles that you are allowed to assign.
strings.choosefilefromuserbackup_help: Private backup files for all courses, with anonymised user information.
strings.config_keep_groups_and_groupings: By default keep current groups and groupings.
strings.config_keep_roles_and_enrolments: By default keep current roles and enrolments.
strings.config_overwrite_conf: Allows user to overwrite the current course configuration
strings.config_overwrite_course_fullname: By default overwrite course full name with the one from the backup file. This requires "Overwrite course configuration" to be checked and current user to have the capability to change course full name (moodle/course:changefullname)
strings.config_overwrite_course_shortname: By default overwrite course short name with the one from the backup file. This requires "Overwrite course configuration" to be checked and current user to have the capability to change course short name (moodle/course:changeshortname)
strings.config_overwrite_course_startdate: By default overwrite course start date with the one from the backup file. This requires "Overwrite course configuration" to be checked and current user to have the capability to roll course dates on restore (moodle/restore:rolldates)
strings.configgeneralactivities: Sets the default for including activities in a backup.
strings.configgeneralanonymize: If enabled all information pertaining to users will be anonymised by default.
strings.configgeneralbadges: Sets the default for including badges in a backup.
strings.configgeneralblocks: Sets the default for including blocks in a backup.
strings.configgeneralcalendarevents: Sets the default for including calendar events in a backup.
strings.configgeneralcomments: Sets the default for including comments in a backup.
strings.configgeneralcompetencies: Sets the default for including competencies in a backup.
strings.configgeneralcontentbankcontent: Sets the default for including content bank content in a backup.
strings.configgeneralcustomfield: Sets the default for including custom fields in a backup.
strings.configgeneralfiles: Sets the default for including files in a backup. Please note: Disabling this setting will result in a backup which only includes references to files. This is not a problem if the backup is restored on the same site and the files have not been deleted according to the setting 'Clean up trash pool files' (filescleanupperiod).
strings.configgeneralfilters: Sets the default for including filters in a backup.
strings.configgeneralgroups: Sets the default for including groups and groupings in a backup.
strings.configgeneralhistories: Sets the default for including user history within a backup.
strings.configgenerallogs: If enabled logs will be included in backups by default.
strings.configgeneralpermissions: If enabled the role permissions will be imported. This may override existing permissions for enrolled users.
strings.configgeneralquestionbank: If enabled the question bank will be included in backups by default. PLEASE NOTE: Disabling this setting will disable the backup of activities which use the question bank, such as the quiz.
strings.configgeneralroleassignments: If enabled by default roles assignments will also be backed up.
strings.configgeneralusers: Sets the default for whether to include users in backups.
strings.configgeneraluserscompletion: If enabled user completion information will be included in backups by default.
strings.configgeneralxapistate: Sets the default for including the user's state in content such as H5P activities in a backup.
strings.configlegacyfiles: Sets the default for including legacy course files in a backup. Legacy course files are from versions of Moodle prior to 2.0.
strings.configloglifetime: This specifies the length of time you want to keep backup logs information. Logs that are older than this age are automatically deleted. It is recommended to keep this value small, because backup logged information can be huge.
strings.configrestoreactivities: Sets the default for restoring activities.
strings.configrestorebadges: Sets the default for restoring badges.
strings.configrestoreblocks: Sets the default for restoring blocks.
strings.configrestorecalendarevents: Sets the default for restoring calendar events.
strings.configrestorecomments: Sets the default for restoring comments.
strings.configrestorecompetencies: Sets the default for restoring competencies.
strings.configrestorecontentbankcontent: Sets the default for restoring content bank content.
strings.configrestorecustomfield: Sets the default for restoring custom fields.
strings.configrestoreenrolments: Sets the default for restoring enrolment methods.
strings.configrestorefilters: Sets the default for restoring filters.
strings.configrestoregroups: Sets the default for restoring groups and groupings if they were included in the backup.
strings.configrestorehistories: Sets the default for restoring user history if it was included in the backup.
strings.configrestorelogs: If enabled logs will be restored by default if they were included in the backup.
strings.configrestorepermissions: If enabled the role permissions will be restored. This may override existing permissions for enrolled users.
strings.configrestoreroleassignments: If enabled by default roles assignments will be restored if they were included in the backup.
strings.configrestoreusers: Sets the default for whether to restore users if they were included in the backup.
strings.configrestoreuserscompletion: If enabled user completion information will be restored by default if it was included in the backup.
strings.configrestorexapistate: Sets the default for restoring the user's state in content such as H5P activities.
strings.confirmcancelquestion:
Are you sure you wish to cancel?

strings.enableasyncbackup_help: If enabled, backup and restore operations will be done asynchronously. This provides a better user experience allowing users to do other operations while a backup or restore is in progress. This does not affect imports and exports.
strings.error_block_for_module_not_found: Orphan block instance (id: {$a->bid}) for course module (id: {$a->mid}) found. This block will not be backed up
strings.error_course_module_not_found: Orphan course module (id: {$a}) found. This module will not be backed up.

strings.errorfilenamerequired: You must enter a valid filename for this backup

strings.errorinvalidformatinfo: The selected file is not a valid Moodle backup file and can't be restored.
strings.errorminbackup20version: This backup file has been created with one development version of Moodle backup ({$a->backup}). Minimum required is {$a->min}. Cannot be restored.
strings.errorrestorefrontpagebackup: You can only restore site home backups on the site home
strings.executionsuccess: The backup file was successfully created.
strings.filealiasesrestorefailures_help:
Aliases are symbolic links to other files, including those stored in external repositories. In some cases, Moodle cannot restore them - for example when restoring the backup at another site or when the referenced file does not exist.

More details and the actual reason of the failure can be found in the restore log file.
strings.filealiasesrestorefailuresinfo: Some aliases included in the backup file could not be restored. The following list contains their expected location and the source file they were referring to at the original site.
strings.filereferencesincluded: File references to external contents are included in the backup file. These won't work if the backup is restored on a different site.
strings.filereferencesnotsamesite: The backup file is from a different site, and so file references cannot be restored.
strings.filereferencessamesite: The backup file is from this site, and so file references can be restored.

strings.importgeneralduplicateadminallowed_desc: If the site has an account with username 'admin', then attempting to restore a backup file containing an account with username 'admin' can cause a conflict. If this setting is enabled, the conflict will be resolved by changing the username in the backup file to 'admin_xyz'.
strings.importgeneralmaxresults: Maximum number of courses listed for import
strings.importgeneralmaxresults_desc: This controls the number of courses that are listed during the first step of the import process
strings.importsuccess: Import complete. Click continue to return to the course.
strings.keptroles_help: Users with the selected roles will be enrolled into the new course. No user data will be copied unless 'Include user data' is enabled.

strings.pendingasyncdeletedetail:
This course has an asynchronous backup pending.
Courses can't be deleted until this backup finishes.
strings.pendingasyncdetail:
Asynchronous backups only allow a user to have one pending backup for a resource at a time.
Multiple asynchronous backups of the same resource can't be queued, as this would likely result in multiple backups with the same content.
strings.pendingasyncedit: There is a pending backup or copy requested for this course. Please do not edit the course until this is complete.
strings.privacy:metadata:backup:detailsofarchive: This archive can contain various user data related to a course, such as grades, user enrolments and activity data.
strings.privacy:metadata:backup:externalpurpose: The purpose of this archive is to store information related to a course, which may be restored in the future.
